SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, MIN(calendar_date) AS d0, MAX(calendar_date) AS d1, MIN(fiscal_week) AS w0, MAX(fiscal_week) AS w1, COUNT(*) AS days, MIN(fiscal_week_start_date) AS ws, MAX(fiscal_week_end_date) AS we
FROM dim_date
WHERE fiscal_period = 4 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26','FY2024/25')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 14 AS first_week, 17 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, st.store_name, st.open_date, st.close_date, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS opened,
           (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date) AS not_closed,
           NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                       WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                         AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                         AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS no_refit
    FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
)
SELECT ty.store_id, ty.store_name, ty.open_date, ty.close_date,
       (ty.open_date IS NULL OR ty.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364) AS open_52_weeks,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ty.opened AND ty.not_closed AND ty.no_refit
                          AND ly.opened AND ly.not_closed AND ly.no_refit) AS weeks_trading_both_years,
       string_agg(CASE WHEN NOT (ty.no_refit AND ly.no_refit) THEN CAST(ty.fiscal_week AS VARCHAR) END, ',' ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week) AS refit_weeks,
       string_agg(CASE WHEN NOT (ty.opened AND ly.opened AND ty.not_closed AND ly.not_closed)
                       THEN CAST(ty.fiscal_week AS VARCHAR) END, ',' ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week) AS not_open_or_closed_weeks
FROM store_weeks ty
CROSS JOIN params
CROSS JOIN range_start
JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
GROUP BY ty.store_id, ty.store_name, ty.open_date, ty.close_date, range_start.first_day
HAVING NOT (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ty.opened AND ty.not_closed AND ty.no_refit AND ly.opened AND ly.not_closed AND ly.no_refit) = 4
            AND (ty.open_date IS NULL OR ty.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364))
ORDER BY ty.store_id

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 14 AS first_week, 17 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id) AS stores, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id || '-' || d.fiscal_week) AS store_weeks
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY d.fiscal_year
)
SELECT ty.stores, ty.store_weeks, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year

SELECT d.fiscal_year, COUNT(DISTINCT r.store_id) AS stores, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctrl_net_sales, SUM(r.net_sales) FILTER (WHERE r.store_id <> 129) AS ctrl_ex129,
       COUNT(*) AS rows_, COUNT(DISTINCT (r.business_date, r.store_id)) AS distinct_rows
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 4 AND r.store_id < 900
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_year, COUNT(*) AS lines, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS dist_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS dist_receipt_lines,
       MAX(etl_loaded_at) AS last_loaded, MIN(etl_loaded_at) AS first_loaded, SUM(net_amount) AS net
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 4
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH s AS (
  SELECT r.store_id, d.fiscal_year, COUNT(*) AS days_with_sales, SUM(r.net_sales) AS net
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 4 AND r.store_id < 900 AND r.net_sales <> 0
  GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT t.store_id, st.store_name, st.region, t.days_with_sales AS days_ty, l.days_with_sales AS days_ly, t.net AS net_ty, l.net AS net_ly, ROUND(100.0*(t.net/l.net-1),1) AS pct
FROM s t JOIN s l ON l.store_id=t.store_id AND l.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND t.fiscal_year='FY2026/27'
JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id=t.store_id AND st.is_current
WHERE t.days_with_sales <> l.days_with_sales OR ABS(t.net/l.net-1) > 0.25 OR t.days_with_sales < 26
ORDER BY pct
